head: Sling Boost Mobile deal: unlimited line for $9.99 a month
dek: Sling TV subscribers who are new to Boost Mobile can get unlimited talk and text with 30GB of premium 5G/4G LTE data for $9.99 a month for six months, then $25 a month, according to Cord Cutters News (17 November). Only in some US markets, for a limited time.
details: You need an unlocked compatible phone and must check out with the email address of your verified Sling account. There's no contract; after 30GB, speeds may slow when the network is busy, and taxes and fees may apply. Up to three lines per online order; lines added later don't get the full six months at $9.99. No end date was given.
where: Select US markets, new Boost Mobile customers with a Sling account, limited time
means: If you pay for Sling and want a cheaper phone line, this cuts the first six months to $9.99 a month, as long as you bring your own unlocked phone.
todo: Check that your phone is unlocked, then sign up on Boost Mobile's website with the email of your Sling account. Note the price goes to $25 a month after six months.
